account: Tests pass (CHK-0174). Public check fails: all 13 example executions raise NameError because the checker runs changed doctest examples in a standalone namespace without the testsetup import. Fix: add '>>> import configparser' as first line of the first new doctest block (before cf_basic = ...). One line insertion fixes all 13 failures since all examples share the namespace.
discussion: All 13 example failures are NameError: 'configparser' is not defined. The checker runs changed examples in a standalone namespace where `__name__='__main__'`, so the `.. testsetup::` import at the top of the file doesn't apply. I need to add `>>> import configparser` as the first executable line in my first doctest block. Since the checker runs all changed examples together in one namespace, this single import will make `configparser` available for both the Basic and Extended interpolation examples.
